summary_markdown: The conversation focused on technical issues with the `staging-mops` system and the need to establish a dedicated staging analytics environment. Initially, there were reports of errors in the `staging-mops` functionality (including database table existence and type errors). Later, it was discussed that creating a new endpoint, `staging-analytics.allunite.com`, is required. While one suggestion was to use an alias for `staging-mops`, it was determined that a separate environment is needed because the team wants to view a different data model and debug a new version simultaneously. It was noted that the existing system has dataset selectors, allowing multiple models (up to seven) to run concurrently.
decisions: A dedicated staging analytics endpoint (`staging-analytics.allunite.com`) is required.
action_items: Determine the specific data model needed for the new staging environment (to be provided by p5).
